topics.title: Visual Hierarchy, Typography Scales & Spacing Systems (8pt Grid)
topics.objective: Establish clear scannability using contrasting font weights, modular size scales, and consistent 8pt spacing.
topics.example: Header: 32px/40px bold; Subhead: 20px/28px medium; Body: 16px/24px regular; Spacing multiples of 8px.
topics.exercise: Design a content card layout establishing prominent visual hierarchy using an 8pt spatial grid.

topics.title: Color Theory, Contrast Ratios & Semantic Palette Design
topics.objective: Construct accessible color palettes (Primary, Secondary, Neutral, Danger, Success) meeting WCAG AA contrast (4.5:1).
topics.example: Primary Button: White text (#FFFFFF) on Deep Blue (#1E40AF) gives 8.6:1 contrast ratio.
topics.exercise: Create a semantic design system color palette and verify that all text combinations meet 4.5:1 contrast.

topics.title: Component Design: Buttons, Inputs, Cards & States (Default, Hover, Active, Disabled)
topics.objective: Design reusable interactive UI components with explicit visual feedback for all interactive states.
topics.example: Button states: default, hover (brightness -10%), focus (2px outline), active (scale 0.98), disabled (opacity 50%).
topics.exercise: Design a comprehensive form component kit including text fields, dropdowns, and checkboxes across all states.

topics.title: Low-Fidelity Wireframing & User Flow Mapping
topics.objective: Translate user requirements into low-fidelity structural wireframes focused on content prioritization.
topics.example: Wireframe screen flow: Search -> Results List -> Item Detail -> Checkout Confirmation
topics.exercise: Sketch a 4-screen mobile wireframe user flow for an appointment booking mobile app.

topics.title: Usability Heuristics & Interface Feedback Systems
topics.objective: Apply Jakob Nielsen's 10 usability heuristics, including visibility of system status and error prevention.
topics.example: Visibility of status: Display progress bar and estimated completion time during file upload.
topics.exercise: Conduct a heuristic evaluation of a checkout flow and redesign error feedback states to prevent slips.
